content.text: All tasks are complete and `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean (exit 0, zero errors project-wide). Here's the summary. ## What was changed **File: `components/marketing/aihostingtemplate/AIHostingTemplate.tsx`** - **Task 1 — hero no longer resizes/jumps.** The `BuildConsole` was reflowing because each animation phase *mounted* new content (the build block, the gate, streaming deploy lines) and the typed prompt bubble grew line-by-line. Now the layout box is fixed: - The prompt bubble renders an **invisible full-length copy of `BUILD_PROMPT`** to reserve its final wrapped height at any width, with the typed text overlaid absolutely on top — so typing never grows the bubble. - The build block, review-gate, and **all** deploy lines are now **always mounted** and only fade via opacity (`showBuild`/`showDeploy` booleans + per-line `deployed > i`). Space is reserved from first paint; the panel height is constant through the whole loop. Transitions are `motion-safe:` gated. - **Task 2 — glow now bleeds instead of being a lit box.** The console's outer ambient glow was a small (`-inset-10`) element whose radial reached the box edge before fully fading. Replaced with a much larger element (`-inset-28`), same-hue **alpha-0** gradient stops, and `filter: blur(44px)` — it fades to full transparency far inside the box and feathers, reading as ambient light with no rectangular edge. The import terminal's inner glow got the same alpha-0 + blur cleanup. - **Task 3 / emoji removal.** Import chips now show **real logos** via decorative `` (the shipped `LogoMarquee` convention: `alt=""` since the brand name sits right beside it) on a clean white tile so every mark reads well. The emoji glyphs (⚡ ♥ ⌘ ◇) are gone. - **Shared — reviews.** The two aggregate star strips (hero + reviews-section header) now render the existing **`ReviewBadges`** component. Since `ReviewBadges` is an async DB-backed *server* component and this template is `"use client"`, it's injected as two `ReactNode` slots (`heroBadges`, `reviewsBadges`) from the route. The per-card `StarRow` is intentionally kept — it mirrors the shipped `ReviewCarousel`'s per-review stars, and a 3-badge Trustpilot/Google strip inside each testimonial card would be wrong. **File: `components/marketing/aihostingtemplate/data.ts`** — `ImportSource.mark` (emoji) → `logo` (logo basename); dropped the emoji values. **File: `app/(marketing)/preview/ai-hosting/page.tsx`** — Full metadata (title, description, OpenGraph, Twitter; kept `robots: noindex` since it's a preview route) + **Product/Offer JSON-LD** (`ProductOffersJsonLd` built from `PLANS`) and **FAQ JSON-LD** (`FaqJsonLd`, 5 honest Q/As matching page copy), reusing the existing `components/marketing/StructuredData.tsx` helpers. Passes the two `` server nodes into the template. **globals.css was not touched** — only inline styles and the existing CSS module / `pv-*` utilities were reused. ## Logos fetched (all real, into `public/logos/`) - **Cursor** (`cursor.svg`), **v0** (`v0.svg`), **Replit** (`replit.svg`) — from **simple-icons** via jsDelivr (`cdn.simpleicons.org` itself is behind a Cloudflare challenge; jsDelivr/GitHub-raw mirror worked). Replit ships monochrome in simple-icons, so I brand-tinted it to its orange `#F26207`. - **Lovable** (`lovable.svg`) — real brand mark from **svgl.app** (`pheralb/svgl`), full-color. - **Bolt** (`bolt.svg`) — the **official bolt.new app icon** (`https://bolt.new/static/favicon.svg`); Bolt and Lovable are not in simple-icons. No fallbacks were needed — all five are genuine marks. All five validated as well-formed SVG XML. One note: `RATING_AVG` in `data.ts` is now an unused export (both former uses became `ReviewBadges`); left in place as a harmless data constant — it's not a tsc error and doesn't warrant churn, but it can be removed if you prefer.
